text: ついに…　ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを　かんせい　させたの　じゃな…！

structure.jp: ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを
structure.en: a truly, truly tremendous, wonderful and perfect Pokédex

structure.jp: かんせい　させたの　じゃな…！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: ものすごくて　すてきで
patterns.explanation: Describing words end in くて or で to line up with the next one, like 'and'. ものすごくて　すてきで = 'tremendous and wonderful and...'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる says you make something happen. かんせい　させた = 'made it complete, completed it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ adds a feeling of 'so it is that...'; じゃ is the old-man だ and な is 'haven't you'. させたの　じゃな = 'so you really did complete it, haven't you'.
